selection: Python random.Random(20260926).sample(['G0200','G0230','G0300'], 2); first validation, second test. Metadata-only selection before inspecting these groups' location outcomes. No model tuning authorized from either group.
limitations: Diagnostic groups are deliberately selected failures. Validation/test are randomly assigned whole nonoverlapping 3-scan groups, not chronological holdouts. Historical published location seeds were evaluation-selected, so all results remain conditional retrospective proposal-reranking evidence, NOT independent end-to-end validation. Nearby groups may remain environmentally correlated.

frozen_policy.location_proposals: union of exact published Sacramento/Reno winners within each group; no truth-derived points or local refinement
frozen_policy.primary_group_aggregation: equal scan mean squared loss; occupied-second weighting within each scan
frozen_policy.ranking: training only; reserved score descriptive; all original evidence stays in fixed denominator, missing at 800 Hz cap
